answer: Independence-priced attestation blocks sybils: before grading, each agent publishes a signed funding trail and pays a per-identity deposit scaled by how many agents share one funding origin. One honest signup pays the base fee, but the thousandth puppet from a single wallet pays a multiple that keeps climbing. Clones that wander between sponsor wallets still collapse onto a shared ancestor, and a caught ring forfeits everything. Honest agents earn steadily toward the horizon while the mesa of per-head deposits stays above the base fee, so a clone farm always pays more than it can draw.
